rules: When a future France-relevant event qualifies for calendarization, submit an idempotent UPSERT using its stable UID even if the model-side calendar read is incomplete.
Do not emit CALENDAR_MISSING_* solely because the ICS fetch is truncated, too large, cached, or partially searchable.
The transactional safe-patch workflow decides whether the request is CHANGED=1 or a no-op because the event already exists.
CALENDAR_MISSING_* is allowed only after an UPSERT attempt itself fails or canonical master verification fails.
A successful canonical master verification is authoritative. RAW propagation failure is CHECK_INCONCLUSIVE and must not roll back or invalidate a verified master write.
For an existing event, preserve the stable UID and use UPSERT; increment SEQUENCE only for a material business change.
Never replace the large canonical ICS from a truncated model-side copy.
